Sub-controls dynamically adapt to [Project] - [Base Setting] - [Shooting Mode] (Custom vs Flexible ISO vs Cine EI vs Cine EI Quick).
Pressing BACK cancels uncommitted value edits and returns to the 6-pillar HOME state.

display_and_commit_rules: Displays up to 8 menu lines per viewport.
Small option sets open a radio/list popup (<= 8 visible lines); wide numeric ranges (e.g., -99..+99 in Paint/Look or WB Tint) highlight inline for direct dial adjustment without opening a popup list.
Pressing BACK before confirmation aborts the in-progress change and restores the prior value.
Action items labeled [Execute] (e.g., Media Format, Reset, APR, All File Load/Save) open a modal confirmation dialog while temporarily hiding the menu tree.

fx3_702_native_model_and_consumers.cp_av_backend: CP 0x4151 setter @ file+0x689f9c (VA 0x791f9d) -> 0x10a8de0+{0xba0..0xbb0} -> GetVfxMlutLookname @ file+0x3266ec -> SetVfxMlutParam @ file+0x3263fc -> VFX SDK @ VA 0xa4f8ba -> mlut_make_lli_table @ VA 0x470f78 -> 70 DMA descriptors @ 0x2025570 -> ISP/MLUT hardware window 0xf4009000 + (combo << 20)

gaps_and_constraints: 1. Stock FX3 AP->CP 0x4151 domain only emits base_look in {0..11, 255}, so CP's dormant entry 22 (`MLUT_LOOKNAME_SL3SG3_TO_ACESREC709` at file+0xbf8ffc, target 0x02015794) is unreachable without the verified 6-instruction AP+CP bridge (`base_look=12`, CP gate `file+0x1cb8a8` `0c29`, selector branch to ID 22).

2. Monitor LUT (`0x2debdb0` BB/VDF `0x92840747`) and Main/Sub Base Picture (`0x2e26fcc` CP `0x90030001` `0x4151`) are already separate IPC channels on FX3, enabling FX5/FX6's per-stream LUT toggle UI, EXCEPT that in Log shooting modes FX3 records S-Log3 + embedded LUT metadata (`sequence_set_embedded_lut`) rather than baking arbitrary 3D LUTs into RAW/Log streams unless switched to Custom/PPLUT mode.

3. Full FX6 Paint parameters (Multi Matrix 16-axis phase/saturation, Skin Tone Detail 3-channel gate, cine knee/shoulder hardware curves) go beyond FX3 Picture Profile parameters and require CP ISP table evaluation (see RAW pipeline review).

fx5_fx6_target_controls: White Balance Mode: Memory A..H (8 memories on FX5/FX6), Preset (5600K/3200K/4300K), ATW, AWB
Color Temp (2000K..15000K) with [Coarse] (100K step) and [Fine] (1K step) sub-modes
One-push AWB Execute

fx3_702_native_model_and_consumers.cp_av_backend: CP 0x4006 setter @ file+0x68950c (VA 0x79150d) writes 0x10a8de0 + {0x9f4..0xa02} and logs 'FW: SET_WB_MODE[%d: %d: %d: %d: %d]' (@ VA 0xdb2fde)

gaps_and_constraints: 1. PROVEN WIRE QUANTIZATION: `appFw.so` `0x2e18e98` (`mov w3, #0x64; sdiv w26, w26, w3; strb w26, [x19, #0x10]`) divides Kelvin Color Temp by 100 and transmits a single byte at `+0x10` (consumed by CP `0x79153c` into `0x10a8de0+0xa00`). Native wire field `+0x10` only carries 100K [Coarse] steps (2500K..9900K).

2. However, wire fields `+0x9..+0xf` carry 2-axis fine shifts divided by 1000 with 16-bit remainders (`+0xc`, `+0xe` -> `0x10a8de0+0x9fa`, `+0x9fc`). To support FX5/FX6 [Fine] 1K Color Temp and Tint (-99..+99) on FX3 without breaking CP ABI, AP must decompose `(Temp_K, Tint)` into `(nearest_100K_byte, fine_AB_shift_mired, fine_GM_shift)` or patch CP's `0x10a8de0+0x9f4..0xa02` WB gain solver.

3. FX5/FX6 has 8 WB Memories (A..H); FX3 native CP wire table (`0x397543c`) has 3 Custom WB slots (`0xa, 0xb, 0xc`). Memories A..H can be persisted in AP model/backup storage and mapped through the active Kelvin+AB/GM payload.

independent_raw_and_color_pipeline_revie.core_conclusion: A 3D LUT (including the 33^3 MLUT table at 0x02015794 / 0xf4009000) is ONLY Stage 4 of a 6-stage imaging pipeline. Porting FX6's full RAW/color behavior to FX3 7.02 requires separating what runs on AP/CP ARM cores from what runs inside the BIONZ XR hardware ISP blocks and CP/AV RTOS tasks.

pipeline_stages.stage_name: Sensor Readout, Dual Base ISO Gain, OB Clamp, Defect Pixel & Lens Shading Correction
pipeline_stages.execution_domain: Hardware ISP Front-End (SIE/IFE) configured by CP RTOS (`cpapp-b.bin`)
pipeline_stages.fx3_vs_fx6_evidence: Both FX3 and FX6 use a 10.2MP full-frame back-illuminated Exmor R CMOS sensor family with 800 / 12800 dual base ISO in S-Log3. CP configures analog/conversion gain and front-end OB/shading registers before demosaic. HDMI RAW output taps linear 16-bit sensor data compressed/packed for Atomos/external recorders.
pipeline_stages.porting_verdict: Hardware ISP front-end is controlled by CP sensor mode tables; cannot be altered by a post-demosaic 3D LUT.

pipeline_stages.stage_name: Bayer Demosaic & Spatial/Temporal Noise Reduction (2D/3D NR)
pipeline_stages.execution_domain: Hardware ISP Core configured by CP RTOS (`cpapp-b.bin`)
pipeline_stages.fx3_vs_fx6_evidence: FX6 Paint/Look exposes explicit Noise Suppression / Detail / Aperture / Crispening / Skin Tone Detail controls. In FX3 7.02, CP configures ISP NR/Detail profiles per shooting mode and ISO index, with limited Picture Profile Detail exposure.
pipeline_stages.porting_verdict: Requires CP ISP parameter table mapping (`cpapp-b.bin`) if FX6 Paint [Detail / Noise Suppression / Skin Detail] controls are to have real pixel effect.

pipeline_stages.stage_name: White Balance Gains, 3x3 Color Correction Matrix (CCM), Pre-Gamma / Log Curve, Knee & Highlight Roll-off
pipeline_stages.execution_domain: CP RTOS (`cpapp-b.bin` WB solver @ `0x10a8de0+0x9f4..0xa02`) -> Hardware ISP Color Matrix & Tone Curve Engine
pipeline_stages.fx3_vs_fx6_evidence: AP sends `0x4006` (`PID_SET_WB_MODE`) and `0x4151` (`BasePictureSetting`) to CP `0x10a8de0`. CP computes R/G/B white balance gains and loads the camera-native-to-working-gamut (S-Gamut3 / S-Gamut3.Cine) matrix and S-Log3 / 709 / HLG transfer curve into ISP hardware registers BEFORE the MLUT block.
pipeline_stages.porting_verdict: Critical upstream color stage! If WB gains (1K fine vs 100K coarse), gamut matrix (S-Gamut3 vs S-Gamut3.Cine), or highlight knee/roll-off differ upstream, feeding the wrong pre-curve signal into an FX6 3D LUT produces incorrect highlight compression and color skew.

pipeline_stages.execution_domain: CP VFX SDK (`VA 0xa4f8ba`) + DMA LLI Builder (`mlut_make_lli_table @ VA 0x470f78`) -> Hardware ISP MLUT Window (`0xf4009000 + (combo << 20)`)
pipeline_stages.fx3_vs_fx6_evidence: Statically and CPU-emulation proven: `GetVfxMlutLookname` (`file+0x3266ec`) selects look ID 0..22 from registry `file+0xbf8ef4..0xbf9004` (including dormant ID 22 `MLUT_LOOKNAME_SL3SG3_TO_ACESREC709` at `0x02015794`, 70 descriptors, 149,888 bytes = 160B header + 3x1984B 1D shaper + 143,748B 33^3 3D LUT + 36B matrix). `mlut_make_lli_table` builds 70x16B DMA descriptors at `0x2025570` for up to 5 hardware combo slots (`combo 0..4`).
pipeline_stages.porting_verdict: Fully mapped and CPU-emulated in `cpapp-b.bin`. Both built-in CP looks (including dormant ID 22) and User 3D LUTs (`0x0229cc00` / `0x02370000`) flow through this exact 70-descriptor DMA engine.

pipeline_stages.stage_name: Output Pipe Split: Main/Sub Codec Recording vs Monitoring (HDMI / LCD / OSD)
pipeline_stages.execution_domain: CP Multi-Combo MLUT (`combo 0..4`) + BB/VDF Display Engine (`0x92840747` in `appFw.so` / `av-cam.bin`)
pipeline_stages.fx3_vs_fx6_evidence: Proven two-path split: (a) CP `0x4151` controls the imaging/recording base picture and CP MLUT combos; (b) AP `vdf_disp_set_monitor_lut` (`0x2debdb0`, msg `200d 0161 000a 8001`) and `ColorGamut` (`0x2dee4ac`, msg `200d 0167 000a 8001`) configure the BB/VDF display assist pipeline (`0x92840747`).
pipeline_stages.porting_verdict: FX5/FX6 BIG6 Look sub-panel separates [Main/Sub Rec LUT] from [HDMI / VF / LCD Monitor LUT]. Adapting this to FX3 requires coordinating `0x4151` (`sequence_set_base_picture_setting`), `sequence_set_embedded_lut`, and `0x2debdb0` (`vdf_disp_set_monitor_lut`) so Monitor Assist does not unintentionally bake into Log recording unless requested.

pipeline_stages.stage_name: UI State Machine, Persistence & Metadata (MXF/MP4 Acquisition Metadata)
pipeline_stages.execution_domain: AP Linux (`appFw.so` `model::*`, `0x821c538` state block) + AV Muxer (`av-cam.bin`)
pipeline_stages.fx3_vs_fx6_evidence: AP stores menu settings in `0x821c538 + offset` and dispatches `model::sequence_set_*::run()`. Notice that FX3 `sequence_set_base_picture_setting` constructor (`0x2c47cfc`) re-reads `0x821c538` getters every time any related setting changes.
pipeline_stages.porting_verdict: Any custom BIG6/FX5 menu state (such as `base_look=12` for ID 22 or WB Memories A..H) must be persisted in AP model state so subsequent `sequence_set_base_picture_setting` runs do not clobber it back to default.

minimal_offline_replayable_experiment.name: CP Stage-3 + Stage-4 Coupled Offline Replay Harness (WB/Gamut + MLUT 70-Descriptor Reference Pipeline)
minimal_offline_replayable_experiment.goal: Without starting a VM or touching camera hardware, replay the exact coupled Stage-3 (WB `0x4006` + BasePicture `0x4151` gamut/log state in `0x10a8de0`) and Stage-4 (CP MLUT `0x02015794` / ID 17..22 160B header + 3x1984B 1D pre-shaper + 33^3 3D LUT + 3x3 post-matrix) numerical chain on synthetic 16-bit linear Exmor R ramps and Macbeth patches.
required_inputs: Extracted CP DRAM MLUT blobs or donor FX6 MLUT blobs (once donor worker extracts FX6 partition)
Synthetic 16-bit linear EXR/raw ramp + 24-patch ColorChecker + +6/-6 stop exposure sweep
steps: 1. Run Unicorn harness from `appFw.so` `0x2e3172c` (`0x4151`) and `0x2e3c3b8` (`0x4006`) into `cpapp-b.bin` `0x791f9d` and `0x79150d` to populate `0x10a8de0` state.

2. Run Unicorn harness through `cpapp-b.bin` `0x8d1ad6 -> GetVfxMlutLookname (0x3266ec) -> SetVfxMlutParam (0x3263fc) -> VFX SDK (0xa4f8ba) -> mlut_make_lli_table (0x470f78)` to capture the exact 70 DMA descriptors at `0x2025570` across `combo 0..4`.

3. Decode the 149,888-byte MLUT payload (3x 1D pre-shaper LUTs + 33x33x33 3D tetrahedral/trilinear lattice + 3x3 post-matrix) alongside the upstream Stage-3 WB/Gamut matrix and compare FX3 ID 17..22 against FX6 donor tables.
4. Measure delta-E (CIE2000) and highlight roll-off slope differences between (a) LUT-only application and (b) full Stage-3 + Stage-4 chain.
minimal_offline_replayable_experiment.what_it_proves: Proves byte-for-byte AP->CP control routing, multi-combo DMA descriptor generation, and isolates how much of FX6's look comes from the Stage-4 MLUT payload vs Stage-3 upstream WB/Gamut/Tone-Curve tables.

downstream_mlut.vfx_sdk_entry: VA 0xa4f8ba (file+0x9478ba) -> resource resolver VA 0x488094 (table 0x13eaff8) -> core VA 0xa14d86 -> queue VA 0xa1f2f2
downstream_mlut.dma_lli_builder: mlut_make_lli_table @ VA 0x470f78 (file+0x368f78) -> 70 x 16B DMA descriptors @ 0x2025570 -> HW ISP/MLUT window 0xf4009000 + (combo << 20)

unicorn_emulation_proof.static_finding_1k_vs_100k: appFw.so 0x2e18e98 executes `mov w3, #0x64; sdiv w26, w26, w3; strb w26, [x19, #0x10]`, quantizing Kelvin color temperature to 100K integer units (5600K -> 56 = 0x38) on wire 0x4006. FX5/FX6 BIG6 [Fine] 1K step control cannot pass 1K granularity through stock 0x4006 byte +0x10 without either translating 1K residual into the 16-bit AB/GM remainder fields (+0xc/+0xe -> +0x9fa/+0x9fc) or extending the CP WB consumer.
